title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Crisp edges, chewy centres, and pools of dark chocolate, deepened with nutty brown butter.
attribution: A tweaked take on the classic Toll House cookie.

steps.text: Brown the butter until it smells nutty, then let it cool slightly.
steps.tip: Watch the milk solids, not the clock — they go from golden to burnt in seconds.

steps.text: Whisk in both sugars, the egg, the yolk, and the vanilla until smooth.
Fold in the flour and baking soda, then the chopped chocolate.
Chill the dough for deeper flavour.
Scoop onto trays and bake until the edges set but the centres still look underdone.
Cool on the tray so they finish setting.
